error[ZBX-E0705]: not a valid state volume name
  while  reading the command line
  cause  the volume name 'PgData' may hold only lowercase letters, digits, '.',
         '-' and '_'
  name   PgData
  fix    name it in lowercase letters and digits, for example:   zbx run --state pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:16
  more   zbx explain E0705
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0705.html
